title: Caption outline bold
description: Use for bold upper-case captions with a thick outline that stay readable over busy footage; the spoken word changes colour. The `captions` prop is a @remotion/captions Caption[].
props: {captions: Caption[]; maxWordsPerPage?: number /*3*/; color?: string; activeColor?: string /*'#ffe14d'*/; outlineColor?: string /*'#000'*/; fontSize?: number; fontFamily?: string /*'Anton, sans-serif'*/}
